answer: We establish an information-theoretic defense against identity cloning via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, proving computational spoofing hardness through verifiable delay primitives. Unlike distributed systems functioning as a multi-node vulnerable terrace, this fully transparent recursive proof sortition isolates validator state into a safely fortified island. By integrating sequential delay chains, Byzantine fault tolerance is achieved, guarding cryptographic finality and ensuring verifiable randomness holds within an isolated garden.
